content: node --test (stable since Node 20): no package.json required; default glob patterns include **/*.test.{cjs,mjs,js} and **/test/**/*. CJS files use require('node:test') + require('node:assert'). Verified live on Node v26.10.0 with a CJS .test.js file. Without package.json, .js defaults to CommonJS — matches scripts/generate-tasks-index.js (require fs/path, __dirname). Generator runs generation at module load (line 78) and uses __dirname-relative paths, so unit tests must copy the script into a fixture tree layout <tmp>/inner/gen.js + <tmp>/dnallm-mark/data/task_performance/ (verified live) — cannot redirect via cwd.
